versions.changelog:
Initial release of GEO Master - Brand AI Visibility Monitor.

- Automatically searches major AI platforms to detect brand keyword visibility and generate a 0–100 GEM score.
- Provides AI analysis of why a brand was not recommended and offers optimization suggestions.
- Supports Feishu push notifications for monitoring reports.
- Multiple pricing tiers with different brand and platform coverage, including a free tier and real-time Pro tier via Tavily API.
- Includes competitor monitoring, quota management, and flexible configuration via JSON and environment variables.
- Quick start commands provided for single/multiple brands and quota/status checks.
